units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 37:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 14:3">Is. XIV, 3</cite>) <he>ומה … ואין לי מהם ת׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Bub. <he>ואין מועילין לי</he>) since I deal kindly with the wicked who provoke me, and of whom I have no profit, how much more with thee &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:3">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>ולא נמצא בם ת׳</he> no good was found in them; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 35">Yalk. ib. 35</cite> <he>תוח׳</he>; v. <cite ref="V00186"><he>תּוֹחֶלֶת</he></cite>.
